scope: Local regression ceilings and hard resource bounds for explicitly declared workloads; they are not hardware-independent service objectives.

policy.semantics: Ceilings detect material local regressions; they are not external SLOs or hardware-independent product promises.
policy.reviewRule: Investigate implementation regressions first. Raise a ceiling only when an intentional corpus or workload change is measured and documented.

measurementPolicy.rule: Keep correctness, work counters, byte ceilings, record ceilings, and safety checks active when a latency ceiling is reviewed.
measurementPolicy.claimBoundary: An unmeasured workload or platform is not qualified by these local budgets.
